explain.say: Here is a small floor of tiles: 2 rows of 3, so 6 tiles. What do you think happens if you make every side twice as long?

draw.text: Why doubling the sides makes the area 4 times bigger

explain.say: Now it is 4 rows of 6. That is 24 tiles. Not 12, but 24! Doubling the sides made the area 4 times bigger. Can you see why?
The floor got twice as long and twice as wide. 2 times 2 is 4. So the area grows by the scale factor squared. Look at the area bar.

explain.say: Volume grows even more. A box with every side doubled is 2 times 2 times 2, which is 8 times as big. Just like 8 small sugar cubes making one big cube.

faq.a: It is the number every length is multiplied by when a shape is made bigger or smaller. A scale factor of 2 doubles every length.

faq.q: Why does area grow by the scale factor squared?
faq.a: Area uses two lengths, length and width, and both get multiplied. With scale factor 2, area grows 2 times 2, which is 4 times.
asks: Why is the area 4 times bigger?

faq.q: Why does volume grow by the scale factor cubed?
faq.a: Volume uses three lengths: length, width and height. With scale factor 2, volume grows 2 times 2 times 2, which is 8 times.
asks: Why is the volume 8 times bigger?

faq.q: What happens if you triple the sides?
faq.a: The area becomes 3 times 3, which is 9 times bigger, and the volume becomes 3 times 3 times 3, which is 27 times bigger.
Weight grows with volume, the scale factor cubed, but leg strength grows with area, the scale factor squared. A giant ant would be too heavy for its legs.

facts: If lengths are multiplied by k, areas are multiplied by k² and volumes by k³.
This rule is called the square-cube law, described by Galileo in 1638.

quiz.say: A photo is enlarged with scale factor 3. How many times bigger is its area?
quiz.why: Area grows by the scale factor squared: 3 times 3 is 9.

wrong.1: 3 times is only the change in length.
wrong.2: 27 times is the change for volume.

quiz.say: A cube has sides of 1 centimetre. Every side is doubled. What is the new volume?

wrong.2: 4 is the change for area, not volume.
